lanes.summary: Release notes say tapping an achievement notification opens trophies (v1.0.1); meal, weigh-in and nutritionist-availability notifications exist, but their tap targets and the signed-out case are undocumented.
Camera (barcode, meal photo), photos and step/water sync are used, but no denied-state handling is documented; manual food search exists as a non-camera path.
sources: Figma node 201:2 (App Store screenshot 2, "Snap your plate.")

lanes.summary: PappAI Premium IAPs ($34.99, $3.99) unlock AI photo recognition, and v2.2.0 added "clearer messages for AI features not in the plan"; no paywall or purchase result was observed.
Free logging has no limits and the nutritionist's plan isn't paywalled, so a lapse likely only removes AI photo features; grace-period handling is undocumented.
Account-based sign-in (with nutritionist code), data synced to the nutritionist, and Restore Purchases exists (fixed in v1.2.3). Doc evidence only; where the restore button sits was not seen.
Listing says "delete your account in the app" and links pappai.it/en/delete-account (the site was unreachable from here); the in-app confirm flow and result were not observed.
Offline is not described. v2.0.3 mentions protecting "unsynced data" across account switches, which suggests local entries queue until sync. Inferred only.
Very frequent releases (v2.3.1, Oct 17; 2.0.2 major redesign) documented only in App Store version history; no in-app What's New was found.

AI photo recognition only suggests editable foods and portions, v2.2.0 added "Clearer messages" when an AI feature isn't in the plan, and manual food search remains; AI failure handling is undocumented.
sources: Figma iEA3Aeu3ApmJdJabmAudXm node 201:2 (App Store screenshot 2, "Snap your plate.")
